movie.title: Dulhaniya Le Aaeegi
movie.overview: A big Fat Indian wedding goes wrong .

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When 32-year-old Navya uncovers a shocking truth about her groom right before her wedding, she embarks on a desperate, chaotic search for a replacement husband to save her ailing father from heartbreak.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Set against the backdrop of a grand Indian wedding in Bareilly, 'Dulhaniya Le Aaeegi' follows Navya, a woman facing immense societal pressure to marry before her timeline runs out. When she discovers alarming secrets about her chosen groom at the last minute, calling off the event isn't an option due to her father's delicate health. Instead, Navya and her close circle quietly launch a impromptu, high-stakes hunt for a suitable replacement. What follows is a flurry of eccentric suitors, family misunderstandings, and hilarious twists as she tries to find true love amidst total celebration chaos.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Navya, a 32-year-old woman, finds herself at the center of a lavish Indian wedding arranged by her devoted but ailing father, Devi Prasad. When Navya uncovers that her prospective groom is hiding a major deceit, she faces a dilemma: cancelling the event could trigger a fatal health crisis for her father, yet proceeding means ruining her own future. Determined to shield her family while preserving her dignity, Navya quietly rejects the groom and orchestrates a secret hunt for a replacement right during the festivities. With the help of her spirited friend, she initiates a modern-day swayamvar beneath the nose of the unsuspecting wedding party. A parade of quirky suitors, ex-partners, and unexpected candidates enter the fray, triggering a series of comical misunderstandings and chaotic situations. As the countdown to the final nuptial rituals ticks away, the pressure escalates, forcing the family to confront their underlying expectations around marriage and tradition. Navya navigates emotional heart-to-hearts with her father, who comes to realize that his daughter's happiness matters far more than societal perceptions. Ultimately, the festive madness unravels in a heartfelt resolution where genuine love triumphs over forced arrangements, delivering a warm and charming family resolution.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Navya is a 32-year-old woman navigating the heavy societal expectations of settling down. When her father, Devi Prasad, arranges a grand, big fat Indian wedding, everything seems set for a picture-perfect union. However, on the eve of the ceremony, Navya uncovers troubling truths about her fiancé's true character. Knowing that a sudden cancellation could shatter her father's fragile health, Navya takes matters into her own hands. She secretly embarks on a race against time to find a worthy new groom before the wedding vows are exchanged, sparking a whirlwind of unexpected romance, laugh-out-loud comedy, and touching family dynamics.

story_structure.climax: As the final wedding timeline nears, emotional confrontations force Navya and her father to confront their deeply held beliefs about marriage, expectations, and personal agency.
story_structure.conflict: Just as grand wedding preparations get underway, Navya uncovers a concerning truth about her chosen groom, forcing her to intervene and stop the arrangement.
story_structure.resolution: Navya chooses a genuine connection on her own terms, helping her family realize that love and life choices shouldn't be governed by societal age pressures.
story_structure.introduction: Navya, a 32-year-old independent woman, faces heavy familial pressure from her wealthy father to get married quickly before an arbitrary deadline.
story_structure.risingAction: Determined to choose her own path, Navya turns the remaining wedding festivities into a modern-day swayamvar, resulting in chaotic suitor rivalries, clashing egos, and escalating family drama.
